findings.title: Save all stays in download mode after one share failure
findings.description: `tap()` sets `downloadNext` to `true` after a non-cancellation share failure, but `createSaveAll` never clears it after the fallback download batch. Because the flag prevents the share check, every later tap—including taps after new photos arrive—downloads instead of trying the share sheet, and the existing test does not reach a later tap.

citations.citation: Generate a fresh random IV for each sealed message

evidence.explanation: Rule 4816117 requires download mode to end after the one batch following a share failure. `downloadNext` is declared at line 26, read by the share decision at line 38, and set to `true` in the failure handler at line 44; the download branch never resets it. The existing test checks only the tap immediately after the failure, so it does not detect the persistent flag.

findings.title: Saving one photo can download it twice
findings.description: `tap()` downloads from a fixed `ready` snapshot without checking whether `save(p)` handed over an item during a download gap. On a laptop, tapping an individual photo that is later in an active Save all batch starts its download immediately, then the batch downloads it again.

evidence.explanation: The individual tap downloads and marks the photo outside the batch's busy guard. The batch waits between items but does not revisit its earlier selection or check the shared handed-over set before downloading.

findings.title: Failed downloads receive no user warning
findings.description: `tap()` announces `Downloading ${ready.length}` before attempting the files, then catches a failed `download()` call only to log it. If starting one or more downloads throws, the person receives no notice that the announced batch was incomplete and must tap again to retry those files.

evidence.explanation: The notification uses the full ready count, while the catch logs a thrown download failure without calling `toast`; the failed PID is not added to `handed`.

findings.title: Photos being verified vanish from the count
findings.description: `saveBatch()` counts arriving photos only in `incoming`, but the receive handler removes a completed transfer from that map before `done()` finishes its asynchronous hash verification and inserts it into `files`. A tap during that interval finds the photo in neither collection and can say `Nothing new to save` without mentioning that it is still being processed.

evidence.explanation: The final chunk removes `incoming` immediately and calls `done()` without awaiting it; `done()` awaits hashing before adding the file. The new batch selection requires `files` for ready and `incoming` for arriving.

findings.title: An unresolved share blocks every later tap
findings.description: `tap()` sets `busy` before awaiting `share(list)` and only clears it when that await settles and reaches `finally`. If the browser's share promise never settles, later Save all taps return `Still saving` indefinitely, with no recovery or explanation of the stalled operation.

evidence.explanation: Every subsequent tap is rejected by the busy check. The only reset is in `finally`, which cannot run while the awaited share promise remains pending.
